items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed, severity high. Do not clear new public exposure or security-sensitive releases. Fleet-doctor has no run, findings, or checks; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days. Compliance reports 36 pass, 19 fail, and 6 unknown, but is a technical baseline rather than certification. Exact decision: preserve private-launch and security-sensitive release gates; permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Continue one consolidated read-only evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only.

Record dated evidence, unknowns, affected scope, owners, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain risk, TLS, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, alter permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach.
